snapshot.title: underdraw next: preview the next task
snapshot.description:
`underdraw next` shows the task `next_task` would offer an agent, without claiming it (NextTask is agent-only and claims).

Needs a proto change first: either a read-only `PeekNextTask` RPC or a `dry_run` flag on NextTaskRequest. Decide which, record a decision note, update `proto/underdraw/v1/service.proto`, run `make gen`, then implement in the service and the CLI. Since the user has no affinity, show the order an agent with no affinity would get.
